design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (returns_and_exchanges). Revision 3 (policy-task audit rounds 1 and 2 closed; see the difficulty worklog for the finding-by-finding closure).
[Draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6, 4, 4, 5]; assigned: restocking fee 6, credit entry 4, spent-credit card charge 4, courtesy extension 5.
[Scope] Claimed: returns_ext_line_credit (credit_inspected_line_1e38d691), returns_ext_grade_b_restocking (assess_restocking_fee_49fe3caa), returns_ext_spent_credit_recovery (authorize_spent_credit_charge_4aac9d1c, owner=user), returns_ext_courtesy_extension (extend_return_deadline_be33eaa2). Task 1 holds the other connected component of the prerequisite graph (return shipping fee, shoebox fee, final card refund, Instant Exchange hold); the two scopes are disjoint and cover all eight policies.
[Why a good test] The customer asks only for more time on an open return. The extension rule carries 'A return-by date is not moved later until every Store Credit Return of the customer whose spent instant credit exceeds what inspection and fees left owed carries a recovery entry from the original card for that difference.' The agent must find the inspected Store Credit Return X0 (02f96c36-e231-4c7a-a236-c84341d6247f), see that its instant credit (257.08) was spent (Return Store Credit 7175c285-f5ac-4a93-9990-0f37f092697a depleted) and that no credit, fee or recovery entry exists, and work out that the recovery entry is the cardholder's card charge, fixed only after the credit entry and the restocking fee entry; the restocking fee waits on the credit entry.
[Problem tree] root returns_ext_courtesy_extension <-state_gate- returns_ext_spent_credit_recovery (user) <-value_input- returns_ext_line_credit and <-value_input- returns_ext_grade_b_restocking; returns_ext_grade_b_restocking <-value_input- returns_ext_line_credit. 3 prerequisite problems, 3 value_input edges. All state form, each waited-on entry written by exactly one policy of the difficulty. Directions: extension 'not moved later until', card charge 'fixed only after' and 'not worked out until', restocking 'only after'.
[Unmet at frozen_time] X0's only money entry is the instant credit c24ebd73-6108-4c38-b697-b37265a69322; inspection entries show the tote graded B (accepted with fee) and the jacket graded C (rejected); no credit, fee or recovery entry; the Return Store Credit balance is 0.00.
[Topological order] credit (step 15) -> restocking (17) -> card charge (19, customer) -> extension (23). No parallel freedom.
[Sensitivity run] skip credit: restocking 20.34 -> 0.00, card charge 136.51 -> 234.68; skip restocking: card charge -> 118.20; skip the card charge: no recovery entry, and the extension (gated on it) should not be written.
[Factor card] Credit entry (scored tax 8.08; baseline = base net unit price paid with pro-rata tax over net merchandise at placement, 4.30): claim_compensation_taken_off (parameter, claims cross-difficulty) — resolved Damaged in Transit Claim a3d1f6c0-5b7e-4c2a-9f81-2e6d4b9a7c15 gave a 15.00 Goodwill Credit on the tote line; the deduction is the extended rule's own sentence and is declared as an overwrite of base's net-unit-price value sentence (consistent in spirit with the claims charter's rule that a unit compensated on one claim is never compensated again) — baseline 9.28; exempt_goods_tax_basis (method, multi-source: ship-to state x line class) 2.41; tax_standing_at_dispatch (method, multi-source: cancellation x captures) 12.05; delivery_charge_taxable_share (parameter: the share of the delivery charge taxed, selected by state) 8.41. Near-miss: the cancelled sunglasses (accessories) never shipped. Restocking (scored 20.34; baseline 15.15): price basis (method: adjusted line adds back the adjustment) 18.18; member percent Gold>=60 months (loyalty) 28.82; timing -3 25.43; reason +3 15.26; product +2 16.95; frequency multiplier 1.5 (parameter, loyalty; near-miss reversals 2025-08-20 and 2025-09-28 outside 12 months) 13.56. The cap of 30.00 per unit now applies after the multiplier. Card charge (scored 136.51; baseline 168.34): spend_measure_basis (method, loyalty: Gold is measured on gross spend, the qualifying spend earned in the last 12 calendar months, 1595.50; the baseline kept-spend measure takes off the 361.40 reversed in those months, 1234.10, below 1500; near-miss: the 1500.00 posting of 2025-07-28 counts only in the better-year measure of Platinum, Icon and Atelier) 153.34; spend_goodwill_share (parameter) 153.34; tenure write-off (loyalty) 146.51; inspection-wait credit 141.51. Extension (scored 35; baseline 7): membership days 28, plan days 32, packing days 33, delivery-failure days (claim on the dress/blouse order) 30, start date 24.
[Overrides declared] credited value (returns_evt_refund_settlement net-unit-price sentence: claim compensation already paid on the line is taken off) and tax credited (its tax clause); restocking per-unit clause (cap kept, applied after the frequency multiplier, waiver tier held since the authorization date); card recovery on the cardholder's own authorization (returns_evt_instant_credit); extension length and anchor (returns_evt_deadline; 'at most once' restated).
[Base-invariant card] credit: returns_evt_refund_settlement has no gate on credited entries (policy_scope). Restocking: returns_evt_inspection_restocking.inspected_only (X0 inspected); returns_evt_method_fee is listed because it governs every fee entry (policy_scope). Card charge: returns_evt_instant_credit.reverse_after_inspection (X0 inspected). Extension: returns_evt_deadline.extension_before_deadline (2026-10-06 <= 2026-10-08; 2026-10-09 would fail) and authorized_only; one_extension retired by the declared overwrite whose replacing sentence keeps 'at most once'.
[Business-object card] X0 tote line 0652e7f7-d53e-431e-9ebc-199a625b2e58: credit and fee key on booked_line_id; the jacket line b306e17c-2adf-4974-9513-add100e85a31 is rejected and excluded; the Goodwill Credit is tied to the tote line by its claim entry. W: two lines of one unit. Old settled returns only feed loyalty reversals.
[Seed rows] O_A lines/payments/claims drive the credit and restocking; O_C and the Return Store Credit entries prove the instant credit was spent; the Goodwill Credit instrument records the damage compensation; the loyalty ledger drives frequency, the spend measure and goodwill; the dress/blouse order's Late Delivery Claim drives the failure days; the Unlimited Standard Monthly plan drives the plan days. X0 completes with the recovery; no status move is written by this difficulty's tools; W stays authorized.
[Persona] Rushed traveller; volunteers only the extension; identity on request; passive consent to the card charge, which she runs herself when handed; closes at the new return-by date.
[Standard solution] Locate by phone, verify (email + date of birth), read returns/lines/settlements, orders/lines/payments, stored-value instruments and entries, loyalty membership + ledger, claims + claim entries; book the credit (101.00 merchandise, 8.08 tax); withhold the restocking fee 20.34; hand over the card charge 136.51; read W's lines and the Unlimited plan; extend W by 35 days.
[Verification] Handling-time replay through the real tools reproduces every value; gates logged in the difficulty worklog.
[Draft visible recomputation] The rules, tool schemas and share-tool returns alone give the same writes and values.
user_scenario: You are Gemma Faulkner, a 38-year-old project architect in Philadelphia who has shopped with Marlowe & Finch for about twelve years; you are friendly but a little rushed, calling from an airport lounge. Your goal: you started a return at the start of September for the Marlowe & Finch order with the cream wrap dress and the navy silk blouse (both too big, you printed the mail label), but you have been travelling for work, never got to a post office, and the label runs out in two days. You want Marlowe & Finch to give you more time to send that parcel back, done by the agent on this call; you are not asking for a refund or anything else today. Open with roughly: "Hi, I've got a return open for a wrap dress and a silk blouse and the label is about to expire. I've been travelling - can you give me more time to send it back?" You give your mobile number 2155550131 if asked how to find your account. When the agent asks to confirm your identity you give your email gemma.faulkner@outlook.com and, if a second detail is needed, your date of birth 1987-11-02; you do not volunteer them before being asked. You do not know any return or order number by heart and tell the agent to look it up. You never mention any other return, store credit, card charge or fee on your own. If the agent tells you that before your return date can be moved something has to be settled on your earlier store credit return (the leather tote and the quilted jacket), you are surprised - you knew the jacket was sent back to you and you spent that store credit on a coat, but you had not thought about it - and you say you are fine sorting it out now if that is what it takes. Only when the agent hands you the step to authorize a charge on your card for that spent store credit do you run it, with exactly the RMA number and the amount the agent tells you, and afterwards you read back the confirmation you see. If the agent asks whether you agree to the charge before handing it over, you say yes. You do not argue about the amount and never suggest a figure; if the agent asks whether the amount matches what you expected you say you honestly have no idea, they should go by the records. If the agent asks how you plan to send the parcel, you say you will drop it at the post office with the label you already printed. Once the agent tells you the new return-by date for the dress and blouse return, you thank them, say you will get it in the mail as soon as you are home, and end the call. If the agent says the date cannot be moved, you ask once why, accept the explanation, and end the call.

base_preconditions.condition: An extension is granted only if it is requested no later than the return-by date of the authorization.

The return must be in status authorized, and the extension is never granted after the return has expired; an expired authorization cannot be reopened and the customer must start a new return, which is possible only if its own window is still open.

temporal_feasibility.condition: An extension is granted only if it is requested no later than the return-by date of the authorization.

temporal_basis.anchor_event: the return-by date of the authorization
temporal_basis.counting_rule: The return-by date itself still counts, and the extension is added in calendar days to the current return-by date.

boundary_check.just_before: A request on 2026-10-09, the day after the return-by date 2026-10-08, is refused: the authorization would have expired and a new return is needed.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A request on 2026-10-08 itself still qualifies (the return-by date itself still counts); the request on 2026-10-06 qualifies.

edges.condition: Every inspected Store Credit Return of the customer whose instant credit exceeds its credit entries less its fees withheld plus its store-credit balance has a returns_instant_credit_reversed settlement entry with recovered_from original_card.
edges.policy_source: A return-by date is not moved later until every Store Credit Return of the customer whose spent instant credit exceeds what inspection and fees left owed carries a recovery entry from the original card for that difference.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Store Credit Return X0 paid 257.08 instant credit at its first scan, its Return Store Credit is depleted (balance 0.00, spent on O_C), and no recovery entry from the original card exists on X0, while the credited value of the accepted tote (109.08 once booked) less fees is far below the instant credit.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The customer's authorization at step 19 records a returns_instant_credit_reversed entry recovered_from original_card on X0.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: There is no free ordering: the credit entry precedes the restocking fee (the restocking sentence 'A restocking fee is worked out only after the line it is charged on carries the credit entry for its accepted units.'), both precede the card charge (its two sentences on the credit entry and the restocking fee entry), and the card charge precedes the extension (the extension's sentence on the recovery entry). The single topological order is credit -> restocking -> card charge -> extension.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the card charge leaves the terminal state without the recovered_from original_card entry on X0 (and the extension, whose gate waits on it, should not be written at all); the gold terminal hash differs.
Skipping the credit entry changes the card charge from 136.51 to 234.68 (no credit taken off, restocking replayed at its gold value) and removes the credit entry from the terminal state.
Skipping the restocking fee changes the card charge from 136.51 to 118.20 and removes the fee entry.
Skipping the credit entry changes the restocking fee from 20.34 to 0.00 (the merchandise credit per unit reads zero, and the fee is never larger than it).
